column2: [intro]
When I listen to his melodies,
I feel like I’m in a TV movie scene,
He has that French charm,
Joe Dassin, he's got the whole allure and calm.
Hey, I really like Joe Dassin,
His style, his voice that’s smooth and gliding,
His songs put me in a trance,
Hey, I really like Joe Dassin.
In "Indian Summer," he makes me dream,
I imagine dancing on the beach, it seems,
And "If You Didn’t Exist" makes me melt,
Joe Dassin, he's my heart that’s felt.
Hey, I really like Joe Dassin,
His style, his voice that’s smooth and gliding,
His songs put me in a trance,
Hey, I really like Joe Dassin.
[solo]
Joe, if you hear me now,
Come do a fiery duet, let’s show them how,
We’ll make all the crowds dance and sway,
With our pop full of laughter and play.
[outro]
